# gdrivescope

> A Bun-native TypeScript CLI for Google Drive. Index a Drive folder into a local graph, summarize and embed documents via a pluggable LLM + embedding provider, and run semantic search over the result. AI-first: primary consumer is agents via `--json`.

## Status

Pre-alpha scaffolding. The CLI stub is wired up but no commands are implemented yet.

## Installation

```bash
# Build from source
git clone https://github.com/SoftwareStartups/gdrivescope.git
cd gdrivescope
bun install
task compile
./dist/gdrivescope --help
```

Pre-compiled binaries will ship via GitHub Releases once the first `v*` tag lands.

## Planned commands

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `gdrivescope login` | OAuth loopback + PKCE flow, store refresh token in OS keychain |
| `gdrivescope logout` | Clear stored credentials |
| `gdrivescope index [--scope FOLDER_ID] [--metadata-only]` | Traverse + extract + summarize + embed |
| `gdrivescope file list [FOLDER_ID] [-r]` | Tree listing from the local graph |
| `gdrivescope file show <ID>` | Node details (path, metadata, summary, topics) |
| `gdrivescope file search <QUERY> [--scope ID] [--limit N]` | Semantic + filter search via sqlite-vec |
| `gdrivescope file download <ID> [-o PATH]` | Raw bytes to disk |
| `gdrivescope ollama setup` | Configure a local Ollama LLM/embedding provider |

## Global options

- `--json` — emit `{ok, data}` / `{ok, error, code}` envelope
- `--version`, `-v`
- `--help`, `-h`

## Environment variables

- `GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID`, `GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET`
- `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `VOYAGE_API_KEY`
- `GDRIVESCOPE_LLM_PROVIDER` (`anthropic` \| `openai` \| `ollama`)
- `GDRIVESCOPE_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER` (`openai` \| `voyage` \| `ollama`)
- `GDRIVESCOPE_OLLAMA_HOST`, `GDRIVESCOPE_OLLAMA_MODEL`, `GDRIVESCOPE_OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_MODEL`, `GDRIVESCOPE_OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS`
